findings.issue: AC16-AC18 were defined twice with different content (scenarios and prose), so AC numbering was broken and criteria duplicated.
§5 X7 cited AC16 (the SCR-45 scenario) and X8 cited AC17 (the view-error scenario). They must cite AC17 and AC18.
TC-E1-011-10 and -11 duplicated TC-ITG-E1011-07 and -08 and pointed at the wrong AC numbers.
Prose AC18 and TC-E1-011-12 judged REC-03/04 breaks, contradicting AC19, AC12 and the NOT_RUN rule until the owners land.
Contract fakes in Background, AC1, AC2, AC4, AC7, TC-01 and TC-08 contradict §12.8, where any fake fails this integration story.
AC1 expected result was changed with no item asking, contradicting the note that the fifteen PASS rows are recorded when S2 and P8 land.
The note after the scenarios still said the legacy scenarios are kept word for word, although their wording was changed.
Step 10 replaced the publish-contract call and put the gate in rwb-source-data, contradicting §11 (gate stays with P3), the actors table and AC1.
AC14 says 'this service' in an integration story that has no service of its own; the case-side reads belong to rwb-case.
AC16 says 'this service' in an integration story; the job and freshness operations are those of rwb-source-data.
AC16 says the loading text is not specified, but §15 says loading is as Screen Specifications v1 gives it.
Disposition says no edit was needed to MSG-P1-012 and MSG-P1-001, but the diff changed both texts under CG-ALL-185 and -186.
